CustomField.description: DESIGNED, NOT SPECIFIED. FSD 5.9.6 step 5 and 5.9.7 both operate on an escalation level and state it is one-way - the level never drops without a payment - but the FSD never defines it. Modelled as a monotone marker: 0 none, 1 = 60 days, 2 = 90 days, 3 = write-off or legal. Raised only upward by the nightly job and reset only on close or payment. Its whole purpose is that an alert fires once.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How far this Case has escalated. 0 none, 1 sixty days, 2 ninety days, 3 write-off or legal. Only goes up.
CustomField.label: Escalation Level
